description: NaB₃H₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaB₃H₈ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.64 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three H atoms. There are two shorter (1.21 Å) and one longer (1.27 Å) B-H bond length. In the second B site, B is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four H atoms. There are two shorter (1.21 Å) and two longer (1.44 Å) B-H bond lengths. There are five inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and one B atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one B atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to two B atoms. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one B atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one B atom.
